title: NHKマイルCの後に・宙吊り

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And it's Agnes Tachyon crossing the finish line, in a tremendous display of dominance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may be the living embodiment of an enigma, but her running never ceases to amaze me.
choice_data_list: (I'll never get tired of seeing you run!)
(I'll never get tired of seeing you run!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see… This is… truly fascinating.
choice_data_list: Well done! You ran like the wind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. You're in a fine mood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, she didn't run in the Japanese Derby, the race I originally suggested to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean I should abandon the rest of our agenda. I still want her to run in the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Next, let's enter the Kikuka Sho!
Next, let's enter the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho G1 race is the next up in your agenda, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm. It is a fine goal! However…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: From here on out, I'd like it if you didn't place too much faith in me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What does she mean by that? In any case, it seems our goal hasn't changed… for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite this uncertainty lingering in the back of my mind, our days training for the Kikuka Sho begin in earnest!
